data.spec: Add optional FacilityRule.schedule:{timezone:IANA string,start:'HH:MM',end:'HH:MM'}|null, default null; overnight range wraps midnight, timezone-aware incl DST, all days. Outside window no new incident/pending debounce; existing active incident can recover on a fresh valid recovery reading, but clock alone never implies recovery. New rules overnight-temperature-low (temp<16C15min reset>=18C) and overnight-humidity-high (RH>60%30min reset<=55%), initial Europe/Oslo22:00–07:00. Alert+local inspection task+station sound (one per incident). Wording 'Possible open window or heating issue' and 'Persistent moisture conditions' — no claim temperature proves window state or mold. Current scalar threshold/no model path preserved. User reconnected USB and requests finish live test; temporary current-time schedule/threshold will be restored after physical temp→alarm→recovery test. No firmware upload.
